name: Biomes and Marine Realms of Elysium
summary: Terrestrial biomes, marine realms, land-use overlay, and flagship organisms, with the canonical ecology render palette.
paletteNote: Elysian vegetation is phyllocyanin teal, not chlorophyll green; xantholin-dominant cold and dormant taxa are amber and rust. Palette values are canonical for the Atlas ecology layer.

terrestrialBiomes.name: Boreal taiga
terrestrialBiomes.summary: Xantholin-gold conifer-analogue forest; the largest biome on Elysium.

terrestrialBiomes.name: Equatorial rainforest
terrestrialBiomes.summary: Deep petrol-blue closed canopy with 110 m emergents.

terrestrialBiomes.name: Temperate broadleaf forest
terrestrialBiomes.summary: Jade in summer, rust in autumn as xantholin unmasks.

terrestrialBiomes.name: Subtropical desert & semi-desert
terrestrialBiomes.summary: Hyper-arid core with salt pans and lithium brines.

terrestrialBiomes.name: Temperate grassland
terrestrialBiomes.summary: The historic agricultural core of the Concord.

terrestrialBiomes.name: Montane & alpine
terrestrialBiomes.summary: Lapse-zoned mountain systems with high endemism.

terrestrialBiomes.name: Tundra & polar barren
terrestrialBiomes.summary: Cushion flora and lichen-analogues on the polar margins.

terrestrialBiomes.name: Oceanic temperate rainforest
terrestrialBiomes.summary: The wettest land on Elysium at up to 5,400 mm/yr.

terrestrialBiomes.name: Wetland & floodplain mosaic
terrestrialBiomes.summary: Disproportionate biodiversity and carbon storage per unit area.

terrestrialBiomes.name: Coastal & littoral systems
terrestrialBiomes.summary: Tidal forest-analogues, dunes, and salt marsh on every coast.

terrestrialBiomes.name: Freshwater lakes & inland seas
terrestrialBiomes.summary: Lake Serapht alone accounts for 96,000 km^2.

terrestrialBiomes.name: Permanent ice
terrestrialBiomes.summary: Veydran Ice Cap (1.42) plus mountain glaciers (0.21).

marineRealms.name: Abyssal plain & deep pelagic
marineRealms.summary: The largest intact ecosystem on Elysium; nodule mining constitutionally prohibited.

marineRealms.name: Continental shelf
marineRealms.summary: Shallow productive shelf; the Mistral Shelf is the richest fishery on the planet.

marineRealms.name: Trench
marineRealms.summary: Deepest point 10,240 m at the Serrance Trench.

marineRealms.name: Kelp-analogue forest
marineRealms.summary: Cold-shelf algal forest on Thalassari, Veydran, and Boreal margins.

kingdoms.name: Zoaea
kingdoms.summary: Motile heterotrophs; four- and six-limbed body plans.

kingdoms.name: Thallidae
kingdoms.summary: Marine primary producers; dominant oxygen source.

flagshipSpecies.name: Skyroot
flagshipSpecies.summary: 110 m emergent tree supporting about 1,200 dependent species.

flagshipSpecies.name: Vailpine
flagshipSpecies.summary: Xantholin-gold conifer-analogue; structural species of the taiga.

flagshipSpecies.name: Frostmane
flagshipSpecies.summary: 900 kg browsing herbivore; keystone of boreal nutrient cycling.

flagshipSpecies.name: Silverdrift
flagshipSpecies.summary: Vast shoaling fish-analogue underpinning the Thalassari fishery.

flagshipSpecies.name: Austral glider
flagshipSpecies.summary: Largest flying animal on Elysium at 6.4 m wingspan.

flagshipSpecies.name: Meshcap
flagshipSpecies.summary: Subsurface network fungus linking forest root systems worldwide.

flagshipSpecies.name: Alcyon lungfish
flagshipSpecies.summary: Survives multi-year drought encysted in mud; cultural symbol of resilience.
